name: heat_time_map_30s
description: Full-span rerun of the 2D map under ONE protocol: 30 s cool everywhere (the 2026-07-30 campaign mixed 15/25/30 s, and cool time measurably changes the response - 850mAx300ms read ~10% larger stroke at 25 s than 15 s). PREREQUISITES: (1) current sense verified after the high-energy sense-death incidents (reseat INA296A OUT->A1 jumper, INA supply, shunt Kelvin taps; check with `read` vs a series DMM) - run with --abort-on-bad-sense; (2) PSU current limit >= 1.5 A. Expected limits: 950x300 and 850x400 near the laser/load-cell ceilings, 950x400 will clip both (force rise >= 3 V; stroke at the laser 0 V rail under default +/-5 mm analog scaling). ~2 h total.
